notes: This expands a previously inspected hypothesis. Freeze targets, pivots, trend, stop and entry rules; do not choose a winning timeframe or asset after seeing new results.
The same 2-left/2-right strict confirmed pivots, HH/HL or LH/LL trend, frozen structural stop, one signal per session, three-candle retest expiry and next-minute execution remain.

Futures retain the original missing-bucket/maintenance reset convention and NY 09:30-12:00,20:00-22:00 entry windows. Crypto uses those same weekday/CME-day entry windows on spot BTCUSD; it does not test unrestricted weekend crypto trading.

Stocks use NYSE regular-session calendars including holidays/early closes, NY 09:30-12:00 entries and exit five minutes before close. Both long and hypothetical short trades are tested, assuming borrow availability; borrow charges and short-sale restrictions are unmodeled.

Stock candles are anchored to the 09:30 open; drop incomplete final buckets. Confirmed stock structure bridges consecutive scheduled buckets across closed sessions, but resets for unexpected missing full buckets. This declared stock-calendar adaptation avoids a meaningless 60-minute test that resets after only six daily bars.

Spot BTC positions use 0.001-BTC units and 0.10% fees on entry and exit notional, plus one basis point of adverse market slippage. Stocks use whole shares and assumed $0.005/share/fill plus one cent adverse market slippage. Both have a one-times-equity notional cap, so actual risk can be well below 1%.
BTC spot is long-only: bearish CHoCH signals do not reserve a session or open a short. It is not a BTC perpetual, margin-short or Bitcoin futures test.
Stock/crypto OHLC are normalized to a cent grid: nearest open/close, outward high/low. Futures data remain on the verified exchange trade-tick grid. This is a research price-precision convention.

All accounts are independent with compounding and no deposits. Futures margin, market impact, stock borrow, dividends and a corporate-action cash ledger are not modeled. Stocks are flat before close and use split-adjusted prices. Named stocks are an illustrative survivor-selected sample, not a historical stock universe.

Cost stress reprices identical fills/quantities at the listed higher commissions and one additional adverse tick on entry and market exits (one additional basis point for BTC), without resimulating size or paths. It is not a forecast or full stressed execution replay.

Four time blocks classify completed trade P&L by entry date. The historical consistency screen is descriptive and not an independent statistical validation or proof of future returns; asset/timeframe cases share data and market regimes.
Report all 17 x 8 x 2 x 2 = 544 cases, plus explicit unavailable/data-quality cases if any. Fewer than 30 trades is insufficient evidence, not a reliable positive or negative result.

Physical futures roll before delivery/expiration using the declared calendar conventions and contract reference data, never realized P&L or hindsight volume selection. Old-contract missing exits retain explicitly tagged last-mark research liquidation assumptions.
No changes to the default live/paper strategy, purchases, broker connections or orders.
